name: OBSESSION♡SYNDROME
source:
What happens when a serial killer finds someone who makes his heart race faster than when he's slicing open throats?

Play as Kyotomi, a yandere with a new found fascination for the cute guy he met recently,  Fuyu-chan. But with Fuyu-chan being such an adorable, friendly, smart guy, you cannot stand by and let someone else snatch him away first. He must be yours. And so, over the next 20 days, you will earn his trust, his affection, learn more about him, and dispose of any obstacles in your way...

[From [url=https://ikemenaddicts.itch.io/obsessionsyndrome]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一名连环杀手遇上了一个比割开他人喉咙更能令自己心跳加速的人，会发生什么？

你将扮演病娇青年清臣（Kyotomi），他对最近邂逅的可爱男生“小冬”产生了无可救药的迷恋。但小冬是如此讨人喜欢、友善又聪明，你绝不能袖手旁观，任由别人抢先把他夺走。他必须只属于你一个人。于是，在接下来的20天里，你将赢取他的信任与好感，深入了解他的一切，并动手除掉一切挡路的障碍……

[摘自[url=https://ikemenaddicts.itch.io/obsessionsyndrome]itch.io[/url]]
